title: Jingle Jingle Freeze 🎄 Christmas Freeze Dance for Kids | Holiday Brain Break | Tiny Turn Up
description:
Jingle when the music plays — FREEZE when it stops! 🎄 A Christmas freeze dance and movement song for kids ages 3–7. Gallop like reindeer, tiptoe like elves and freeze like a snowman with Jojo, Kiki and Waddles!

Perfect for December classroom brain breaks, holiday parties, PE warm-ups and Christmas dance parties at home.

New Tiny Turn Up dance songs every week!
#christmasfreezedance #christmassongsforkids #brainbreak
thumbnail_prompt: Jojo in a Santa hat frozen mid-gallop inside a sparkly ice effect, Kiki in reindeer antlers ringing jingle bells, Waddles in a tiny elf hat sliding on a sled; snowy playground court with Christmas lights and a decorated tree. Right third: bold text 'JINGLE FREEZE!' in red and white with thick black outline, and small text 'TINY TURN UP' with a gold crown.
